title: Honest Bar
summary: A bar chart that admits when its axis doesn't start at zero and says how much that exaggerates, like "looks 3×, really 1.09×".
description: Pure-SVG bar chart that, when the axis doesn't start at zero, draws a broken-axis mark, states the distortion (lie factor) with a one-tap Start at 0, tears and labels values past the scale, and reads exact values on hover and keyboard focus.
catches: Truncated value axis that makes small differences look large
Values clipped past the scale: torn and labelled
Exaggeration stated as drawn ratio vs real ratio
limits: One series of bars; not a general charting library
The lie factor compares longest and shortest bars only
Ignores other distortions such as 3D, dual axes or log scales
a11y: Chart is a labelled list; each bar is a focusable listitem with an aria-label holding the exact value
Arrow keys, Home and End move between bars
Status about truncation is in a polite live region
The broken-axis warning has text, not only a visual mark
mistakes: y axis not starting at zero
